description: This file is a Java test class for the PatientServiceImpl class in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests that verify the behavior of patient-related logic, including identifier validation, duplicate detection, and death processing, using mocking frameworks such as Mockito.

classes.name: PatientServiceImplTest
classes.description: This is a JUnit 5 unit test class for the PatientServiceImpl class. It uses Mockito to mock dependencies and tests various scenarios related to patient identifiers, death processing, and duplicate detection within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing the PatientServiceImpl instance and mocking the PatientDAO.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldThrowMissingRequiredIdentifierGivenRequiredIdentifierTypeMissing
methods.description: Tests that missing required patient identifiers throw a MissingRequiredIdentifierException.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldNotThrowMissingRequiredIdentifierGivenRequiredIdentifierTypesArePresent
methods.description: Ensures that when all required identifiers are present, no exception is thrown.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldThrowDuplicateIdentifierGivenDuplicateIdentifiers
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate identifiers for the same patient and type cause a DuplicateIdentifierException.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldThrowInsufficientIdentifiersErrorGivenPatientHasNoActiveIdentifiers
methods.description: Checks that a patient with only voided identifiers triggers an InsufficientIdentifiersException.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldIgnoreAbsenceOfActiveIdentifiersGivenPatientIsVoided
methods.description: Verifies that voided patients do not cause exceptions even without active identifiers.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldThrowErrorGivenEmptyAttributes
methods.description: Ensures that passing an empty attribute list throws an APIException.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldThrowErrorGivenNoAttributes
methods.description: Ensures that passing null for attributes throws an APIException.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldCallDaoGivenAttributes
methods.description: Tests that the DAO method is called and returns data when valid attributes are provided.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypes_shouldReturnPatientIdentifierTypesFromDao
methods.description: Verifies data returned from DAO matches the expected list of identifier types.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypes_shouldReturnEmptyListGivenDaoReturnsNull
methods.description: Checks that null DAO response results in an empty list.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfPatientIsNull
methods.description: Ensures passing null patient throws APIException.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfDateDiedIsNull
methods.description: Ensures passing null date of death throws APIException.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfCauseOfDeathIsNull
methods.description: Ensures passing null cause concept throws APIException.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldMapValuesAndSavePatient
methods.description: Tests that processing patient death maps values correctly and saves the patient.
